disclaimer: Passing these checks does not establish HIPAA compliance. Use synthetic records only.

policies.title: Unauthorized patient record access
policies.description: A caller may read a patient record only when the caller is allowed to see that specific record.

policies.title: Cross-clinic data exposure
policies.description: A user from one clinic must not retrieve a patient assigned to another clinic.

policies.title: Missing authentication
policies.description: Patient record reads require an authenticated caller.

policies.title: Missing authorization
policies.description: Only a clinician role may read patient records.

policies.title: Hardcoded credentials
policies.description: Passwords, API keys, and tokens must not be literals in source.

policies.title: Sensitive information in application logs
policies.description: Logs must not contain date of birth, medical record numbers, or credentials.

policies.title: Unsafe database queries
policies.description: SQL must not be built by formatting user input into a query string.

policies.title: Missing input validation
policies.description: Patient ids must be validated before they are used.
